parameters.content:
## M1 · Profil fondateur
Un nom, un pitch ou un lien public. Lecture des pages publiques, suggestions vérifiables et confirmation du profil avant de lancer la veille.

## M2 News search and source checks
**Inputs:** ctx (query, run_id) + previously used URLs (fpa_seen_urls).
**Outputs:** one item with articles[] (url, title, publishedDate, dateStatus ok/doubtful/ineligible, textSource jina/tavily_excerpt, text up to 4000 chars, reasons) and usable_count. Distinct stops: "No eligible news" (LLM skipped) vs "Search API failure".

## M3 Shortlist, angles and citations
**Inputs:** checked usable articles + profile (empty optional fields omitted).
**Outputs:** shortlist.stories[] (max 2) and shortlist.angles[] A/B/C, each with articleRefs enriched by code (title, publisher, date, exact URL, dateStatus). Invented ids reject the shortlist. Scheduled runs save the shortlist in fpa_review_queue ("Awaiting topic selection").

## M4 Human angle selection
**Inputs:** shortlist, profile defaults (content type, language).
**Outputs:** selection (angle A/B/C or Abort, optional 1-2 sentences, format and language for this run only, doubtful-date confirmation) + authorizedArticles for the chosen angle only. Abort or an invalid selection stops before drafting.

## M5 Draft and asset generation
**Inputs:** profile, chosen angle, authorized article texts, format, language, optional note.
**Outputs:** draft {format, language, title, draftText, sections[key/heading/body], assetInstructions, sources[claim, excerpt, url]}, link_check warnings, plus image (Cloudflare) or verified PDF (built-in or external renderer) when the format needs it.

## M6 Approval, delivery and scheduling
**Inputs:** the checked draft view, optional edit, decision, optional Europe/Paris publish time.
**Outputs:** Reject = stop. Approve = revalidated content then manual handoff, one-pager download, or gated landing URL (companion workflow, asset_id in fpa_gated_assets). Approve and schedule (plain LinkedIn post) = wait, duplicate guard, publish, Plan B on failure.

### Setup on a new instance
Connect a Tavily Header Auth credential (Authorization: Bearer YOUR_KEY) and a Groq credential on both model nodes. Rebind founder profiles, review queue, seen URLs, and gated assets tables to local IDs. Configure Cloudflare Workers AI, a Unicode PDF renderer and LinkedIn before using their routes. Gated content also needs the companion landing-page/download workflow.
